headline: Executive session on deployment of security personnel, devices, or strategies related to safety.
summary: The School Committee will meet in executive session to discuss security personnel, devices, or strategies regarding safety. The committee will also hold a public participation period before entering executive session.
items: Executive Session Pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, Section 21(a)(4) to discuss the deployment of security personnel or devices, or strategies with respect thereto; Safety
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
